notes: An account whose usage poll was throttled no longer drops behind the rest of the auto pick order. aliax-core 2df7622: orderByReset (failover.ts) demotes an account for a live report.rateLimit mark only when it has no windows on file, since that mark comes from GET /api/oauth/usage answering 429 and says nothing about the model API, while the cached windows still show the room; and a usage() sweep (accounts.ts) stops knocking after its first 429 with a retry-after, serving the remaining accounts from cache unmarked, because the throttle is on the host and one restart had marked eight of eleven accounts within a second. On 2026-09-28 that mark made a Fable thread pick Company (week resets in four days) over landon@firegames.gg (room left, resets in ten hours). Test in accountRouting.test.ts: chooseAccount with no current account picks the marked soonest-reset account with room.
